# 🔍 CommandSpyPlus

A powerful, modern, and secure command monitoring system for staff.

CommandSpyPlus is a lightweight yet advanced plugin designed to give server administrators full visibility over player command usage — without spam, clutter, or performance impact. Built for serious servers, it provides intelligent filtering, clean formatting, and deep customization.

![Showcase](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/18fae24e653270ad7fc5af3958dbcc7460098176_0.webp)

## ✨ Features
### 🧠 Smart Command Monitoring
- See commands executed by players in real-time
- Optional filtering (ignore specific commands or players)
- Clean, readable format — no spammy logs

![Showcase](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/82910c377cd33607f9c01659b4fcdb9a84d1245f.png)

## 🔐 Permission-Based Access
- Full integration with permission systems like LuckPerms
- Separate permissions for:
- Viewing commands
- Bypassing spy
- Admin controls

## ⚙️ Fully Customizable
- Edit messages, formats, and colors in language.yml
- Configure behavior in config.yml
- Choose which commands to track or ignore

## 🧹 Anti-Spam System
- Prevents flooding staff chat
- Optional cooldown between repeated commands
- Grouping system for repeated actions

## 📊 Advanced Filtering
Ignore commands by:
- specific players
- command prefixes (/msg, /login, etc.)
- Whitelist / blacklist support

## 🔔 Toggle System
- Staff can enable/disable spy mode with a command
- Saved per player (persistent across restarts)

## ⚡ Lightweight & Optimized
- Minimal performance impact
- Async-safe logging system
- Designed for high-player servers

## 🧾 Commands

```
/commandspy
```
 → Toggle command spy

```
/commandspy reload
```
 → Reload configuration

## 🔐 Permissions

```
commandspy.use
```
 → Use command spy

```
commandspy.admin
```
 → Reload config

```
commandspy.bypass
```
 → Commands won’t be shown to others

## 🧩 Compatibility
- Supports Paper/Spigot/Bukkit (1.20+ recommended)
- Works perfectly with LuckPerms
- Compatible with most server setups

## 🚀 Why CommandSpyPlus?

Unlike basic command spy plugins, CommandSpyPlus focuses on:

- clarity over spam
- control over noise
- performance over bloat

It’s built for real servers — not just simple setups.


## ❤️ Support

If you need help or want to suggest features, feel free to reach out.
